guard: cotal_join tells a family follow from a live-only pattern, refuses a name that is no channel name, and checks a pattern's read ACL by containment
why: J1 drops the channel-name check, so team.** reaches joinChannel, which rewrites it onto another subject.
J2 checks a pattern's read ACL by matching instead of containment, so perm.> passes under perm.*.
J3 gives a family with its membership the concrete channel's headline, which promises a replay of every offline post.
J4 gives a pattern with * the LIVE only headline of a channel whose backstop failed.
J5 gives a family whose backstop failed the headline of a pattern with *, hiding the failure.
J6 drops the pattern's registry line, so a family reads as a name a prior send invented.
J7 drops the sentence on what a family keeps from the cotal_join description.
NO BUILD STEP: the suite imports ../src.
J8 drops the name check from cotal_channel_info, so team.>.x is described as a pattern.

mutations.name: J1 a name that is no channel name reaches joinChannel
mutations.find:
const notName = notAChannelName(channel, "Nothing was joined.");
        if (notName !== undefined) return err(`Couldn't join: ${notName}`);
mutations.expectRed: "team.**" is refused as no channel name before anything joins
mutations.cell: "team.**" is refused as no channel name before anything joins
mutations.note: The endpoint would subscribe to team.__ while the tool reports #team.**.

mutations.name: J2 a pattern's read ACL is checked by matching, so perm.> passes under perm.*
mutations.expectRed: perm.> is refused as outside the read ACL (perm.* covers one segment under perm)
mutations.cell: perm.> is refused as outside the read ACL (perm.* covers one segment under perm)
mutations.note: perm.> matches perm.a.b, which perm.* does not cover; the broker would refuse the subscription after the tool let it through.

mutations.name: J3 a family with its membership gets the concrete channel's headline
mutations.expectRed: a family joined with its membership says stored copies are on for its durable channels
mutations.cell: a family joined with its membership says stored copies are on for its durable channels
mutations.note: The concrete headline promises every offline post replays; a family keeps stored copies only on its durable channels.

mutations.name: J4 a pattern with * gets the LIVE only headline of a failed backstop
mutations.expectRed: a pattern with * joined says live only and why
mutations.cell: a pattern with * joined says live only and why
mutations.note: A pattern with * has no backstop to fail; its headline says it is live only by design.

mutations.name: J5 a family whose backstop failed gets the headline of a pattern with *
mutations.expectRed: a family joined without its membership says live only and that offline posts are not kept
mutations.cell: a family joined without its membership says live only and that offline posts are not kept
mutations.note: A family follower whose membership failed must hear that its offline posts are not kept.

mutations.name: J6 a pattern's info says a prior send may have invented it
mutations.expectRed: the family's info says a pattern has no registry entry of its own
mutations.cell: the family's info says a pattern has no registry entry of its own
mutations.note: A send cannot create a pattern, so the unregistered-name line misleads.

mutations.name: J7 the cotal_join description drops what a family keeps
mutations.find: "Under a family such as review.>, posts on its durable channels are kept for you while you are offline, from the join on, and its live channels reach you only while you are connected. " +
mutations.expectRed: the cotal_join description says what a family keeps
mutations.cell: the cotal_join description says what a family keeps
mutations.note: An agent reads the description before it joins.

mutations.name: J8 cotal_channel_info describes a malformed pattern as a pattern
mutations.find:
const notName = notAChannelName(channel, "Nothing was looked up.");
        if (notName !== undefined) return err(`Couldn't look up the channel: ${notName}`);
mutations.expectRed: cotal_channel_info refuses a malformed pattern as no channel name
mutations.cell: cotal_channel_info refuses a malformed pattern as no channel name
mutations.note: team.>.x is no channel name, so describing it as a pattern misleads the agent.
